front: How do you find the passage author's own view in a comparative piece?
why: Locating the author's own view is asked on nearly every multi-view passage

front: How do you handle a question asking what both authors would accept?
why: Both-would-accept is a niche question type; overlap tactic is a second step

front: How should you annotate a comparative passage?
why: Annotation habit helps but is not itself a tested skill

front: What if the author appears neutral between two positions?
why: Neutral-author case is uncommon; secondary scope check

front: What is a comparative CARS passage?
why: Definition of the passage type; no tactic, trivia-grade

front: What is a frequent trap in comparative passages?
why: Misattributing a view to the wrong thinker/author is the core CARS trap, tested every year

front: What question type is most common here?
why: Analogy/application is one question type among several; niche framing

front: What should you track most carefully in a comparative passage?
why: Agree/diverge boundary drives most comparative-passage questions
